video_title: Championship Expectations for Luka’s Lakers | The Hoop Collective

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' persistent pursuit of Walker Kessler finally succeeds
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers tried to acquire Walker Kessler on several different occasions. And they weren't able to get him.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Lakers tried to acquire Walker Kessler on several different occasions. And they weren't able to get him because they weren't willing to pay the price. The Jazz asked for more now than they had ever asked for before and the Lakers said yes. I think the reason is because they knew how badly Luka Doncic wanted him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' financial flexibility made the Walker Kessler trade possible
quotes.excerpt: This was the one summer that they had that kind of financial flexibility.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: They knew that it was kind of a now or never thing for the Lakers because this was the one summer that they had that kind of financial flexibility. You had to do it with Austin Reaves getting his payday. You had to do it now.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Now maybe they could have done something via the trade market, but in terms of a sign-and-trade type of deal, signing a center, this was their one swing and they had promised Luka Doncic this is the summer that we're going to get you that rim-protecting and rim-running pick-and-roll partner big man and they did it.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves' status as a max player brings higher expectations
quotes.excerpt: The great news is that you're a max player. The troubling news is that everybody knows it.
quotes.quote: I spoke to Austin Reaves one-on-one. I said, Austin, whoa buddy, let's find out what happened here. And it turned out that yes, Luka Doncic beat him with the handicap and that Austin gave Luka 23 shots. I said to Austin, I got great news and troubling news. The great news is that you're a max player. The troubling news is that everybody knows it. And so people are going to hold you to a different standard. He goes, yeah, I'm aware, I understand that. But he's like, I talked to Luka before I did this and I could have gone elsewhere, but I wanted to be with Luka.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' front office prioritizes Luka Doncic's happiness for extension
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers organization is very cognizant that they need to be in a good place with Luka.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Lakers organization is very cognizant that they need to be in a good place with Luka Doncic at the end of the season so they can get him extended. There's a lot of different goals for the Lakers season, this is not number one, but the organization is aware, which is one of the reasons why they felt the need to make sure they went out and got him a center.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: And they knew that it was kind of a now or never thing for the Lakers because this was the one summer that they had that kind of financial flexibility.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's championship expectation for the Lakers this season
quotes.excerpt: My expectation is we win a championship. This is what we're doing here.
quotes.quote: I didn't have an expectation for his answer, I just wanted to see how he answered it. And so he said, my expectation is we win a championship. He's like, this is what we're doing here.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's mental state remains strong despite championship pressure
quotes.excerpt: He is in a very good mental place.
quotes.quote: Regardless of whether the Lakers have a real chance or not, I think it goes to where Luka is. He is in a very good mental place.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's consistent confidence throughout his career
quotes.excerpt: Luka has never lacked confidence. He is a supremely confident gentleman.
quotes.quote: Luka has never lacked confidence. He is a supremely confident gentleman. And he said that throughout the year the Mavericks made a finals run that by the way they had to win three road playoff series to get to. So I think he genuinely believes it. It's just not a real departure for him in terms of mindset.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's unique intersection of age, talent, and status
quotes.excerpt: Luka is at the intersection of age and talent/status to where the lack of a championship becomes weighty.
quotes.quote: Luka is at the intersection of age and talent/status to where the lack of a championship becomes weighty. This is his ninth season, he's been around for a while. It's a credit to him, but a perennial MVP candidate who hasn't won a championship yet, it becomes a thing.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Rob Pelinka's roster construction empowers Luka Doncic as a partner
quotes.excerpt: Rob Pelinka has empowered Luka to be a partner in team construction.
quotes.quote: The way the Lakers have built this team, Rob Pelinka in particular, he has empowered Luka Doncic to be a partner in team construction. And so one would hope that he is going to then espouse the merits of this group and see the pie-in-the-sky version of what they're capable of accomplishing because he had input in the decisions they were making, principally the decision to put all those assets towards Walker Kessler.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's leadership evolution and European training camp
quotes.excerpt: Luka realized LeBron was not there, he needed to take another step as a leader.
quotes.quote: Luka realized LeBron James was not there, he needed to take another step as a leader and so he wanted to spend time with his teammates. He basically ran an event that was like a European national team training camp. When the European national teams get together, they totally go into a bunker together. All meals are together, all free time is together, other than sleeping, the guys spend the time together.
